71574.text: Stomatal transpiration takes place during day time in the following plants EXCEPT________.
71574.sol: Cactus is a xerophytic plant that exhibits Crassulacean Acid Metabolism (CAM). Therefore, stomatal transpiration does not take place during the daytime in Cactus, whereas it occurs during the daytime in Lotus, Mango, and Grass. Answer: Cactus

95286.subject: Botany
95286.text: Which one of the following is NOT a characteristic of meristematic cells?
95286.sol: The cells residing at the root and shoot tips are known as meristem cells. These are undifferentiated cells and are responsible for the plant growth due to its ability to divide. 304626.text: A raindrop descending near the surface of the earth maintains an almost uniform velocity because

the viscous force of the air balances its weight
the atmospheric electric field balances the weight of the charged drops
304626.sol: When a raindrop falls under gravity, it accelerates initially. As its velocity increases, the upward viscous drag force exerted by the air also increases. According to Stokes' law, the viscous force is directly proportional to the velocity of the raindrop ( F_v = 6 r v ). When this upward viscous force becomes equal to the downward weight of the raindrop, the net force acting on it becomes zero. 306236.text: The decay constant of ²³⁸ U is 4.9 10⁻¹⁸ s ⁻¹ . By what factor will the activity of a ²³⁸ U sample decrease in 9 10⁹ years ?
